###Example: They will conquer [them]. (= Japan/Iran/France/Italy/France/USA/Cuba] => Ils vont [le]/[la]/[les] conquérir (= le Japon/l'Iran/l'Italie/la France/les États-Unis/Cuba.
defined_text = {
	name = GetLeLaFNP

##### Cosmetic Tag (1) + Country Tag (2) + Ideology + Subject	430 #####
	text = {
		trigger = {
			is_subject_of = ITA
			has_cosmetic_tag = BOS_without_HRZ
			has_government = fascism
			is_subject = yes
		}
		localization_key = FRLOC_LE

	name = GetSesLeursNP

	name = GetSilSielleNPCap
